model: Operation Downfall V1.2 eight-year network, MFG, optimal-transport, game-MPC and stratified semi-Markov competing-risks model

survival_model.family: structure-stratified semi-Markov multi-state model with time-varying cause-specific Cox hazards
transitions: decision-ready -> palace blocking -> delayed return to decision-ready
central order -> coordinated surrender or fragmented surrender
survival_model.estimation_warning: Transition coefficients are transparent counterfactual priors, not fitted event-history estimates.
survival_model.why_not_plain_cox: Palace blocking is recurrent and nonterminal, so a one-event Cox model would remove paths from the risk set incorrectly.

warning: Historical counterfactual conditional on model structures; not an objective forecast.
historical_cases_role: mechanism-prior calibration and leave-one-out validation only
